LanguageData.RavenResearch_LiquidTerraforming.label: [Raven] Fluid Terraforming
LanguageData.RavenResearch_LiquidTerraforming.descrip: Unlocks the ability to terraform by pouring bottled Raven fluid onto natural ground to form shallow or deep fluid lakes. You can also use concentrated fluid fertilizer to upgrade ordinary soil into highly fertile Raven soil.
